mcq.question: Why was `for (const auto& e : Ledger(file).entries())` a bug in C++20?

options.C: The temporary Ledger is destroyed before the loop runs, so the loop reads freed memory

mcq.explanation: Only the result of `entries()` would be lifetime-extended, and it is a reference into the dead temporary. C++23 fixes this case.

mcq.question: What does exit code 2 from `budget` tell a script?

options.A: The command line was wrong: a usage error

mcq.explanation: Usage errors (2) are distinct from data and I/O errors (1), so scripts can react differently.
